name: Bodua
text: Bodua is a war-goddess honoured in Gaul. The battle figure closely mirrors the Irish goddess Badb. Old writers also gave her the titles Cathubodua and Cauth Bova. Bodua stands for the fury and carnage of fighting. Her name links the war-gods of the Gaulish and Irish worlds of battle.

attributes.attribute: also called Cathubodua and Cauth Bova

okr.objective: Present Bodua as the Gaulish war-goddess parallel to the Irish Badb.
key_results: She closely mirrors the Irish Badb.
Her other titles are Cathubodua and Cauth Bova.
